summary: Wrapper around SessionStateCheck: queries the current session state via a __thiscall and returns TRUE when the state is either 2 or 1, FALSE otherwise. The incoming 'this' is forwarded unchanged to SessionStateCheck.

operations.description: Call SessionStateCheck(this) and store the returned session-state integer.
Compare the returned state against constant 2 and constant 1; accept the result when either comparison is true.
Return the boolean result of (state == 2 || state == 1).

unresolved: Meaning of the session-state constants 1 and 2 and which callers depend on each value.
Relationship between 'this' and the session object consumed by SessionStateCheck.
